headline: EPS extends its climb on both comparisons
summary_short: Kato Sangyo reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥156.80, up 55.5% y/y from ¥100.82.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥156.80 rose 55.5% year-over-year from ¥100.82, and was up 8.1% sequentially from ¥145.06 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
